label: C1: complete derivative systems, totality esse-cause route and the Hume-Edwards rival (#1724)
summary: Issue #1724 (with #1616 scope): C1 = every complete nonempty system of actual derivative beings depends on something underived. Read as C1-bearer it is exactly CCR 20babef7 on the fixed q3a4 ActualEsseCause; C1-anything (an underived fact or law outside the bearer domain) is unformalized and feeds no root route, and most listed alternatives (necessary impersonal totality, a universe that is itself an unreceived bearer, priority monism with an unreceived cosmos) accept C1 and contest later bridges. Derivation attempts: (a) plural non-circularity restricted to complete pluralities restates CCR; unrestricted it has well-foundedness strength (044974e5), which CCR does not need; individual no-self-causation does not yield it (Hume-Edwards control satisfies no self-causation and loop freedom). (b) New verified route, zero-axiom, Comparator/NanoDa: totality cause A 05b15c98 + whole to members B 6c0282c0 + no self-causation b62a64ab give one uncaused cause of every received bearer 9ff2814e (a89fd4df), which gives CCR (50dda707, strength relation 37885377) and, with 457698e4, a576300f, cffad050 and excluded middle, the GOD_4-bundle input da09703b without CCR, population or composition b4987085 (0773fa6c). Seven controls (69ed38fb): joint model with infinite descent; one model omitting each of A, B (twice) and no self-causation; CCR without a common cause on given edges and with two independent roots. A is stronger than C1 (it builds in unity of the cause of received being; plural foundations keep C1 and reject A), so it adds a support option, not independent warrant for CCR. Canonical assessment: docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, C1 section.
blocker: No formal blocker; the remaining disagreement is explanatory. Whether actuality by reception is a grounded property (attributions must reach an unreceived giver, least fixed point) or can be satisfied coinductively by an endless or circular system of givers (greatest fixed point). All structural tests are settled by the controls. Provisional judgment: C1-bearer at exhaustive per se productive supply scope accepted provisionally as a defended primitive, modestly favored; unrestricted tenseless mode-unspecified reading underdetermined (#1616 inertia and non-efficient modes, open bridge cb1cdea9); Hume-Edwards and bearerless-primitive-fact versions of the denial coherent and not refuted. The contrastive warrant for C1 over the regress needs a source active in every admissible state (a C2 commitment); the mode-of-having warrant does not. Reopen for: an argument that received does not transfer from members to a complete totality beyond the Hume-Edwards denial; a positive account of how a bearerless fact makes bearers actual; a same-relation counterexample to B or to no self-causation; a defended per se productive reading of every r-edge; a typed mode-specific variant changing the regress control's interpretation.
